get.description: The service artists shown as this library artist, tied by matched songs or by a person's answer, and the ones someone said are a different act. Ids may be v2 artist ids or the older media server and `ext-` artist ids.

put.description: Says whether a service artist is the same artist as this library artist. An administrator's answer covers the household; a listener's covers only them and wins over the household's for them. Search and artist pages follow at once. Ids may be v2 artist ids or the older media server and `ext-` artist ids.

delete.description: Takes back this person's answer, so matched songs decide again. An administrator can take back a household answer. A listener cannot take back the household's answer (403); they can mark it as not the same for themselves instead. Ids may be v2 artist ids or the older media server and `ext-` artist ids.

post.description: Runs up to 20 v2 reads in one round trip and returns each one's status and body by its `id`. Only v2 GET routes can be batched. Each result carries the standalone route's ETag; `ifNoneMatch` returns 304 without a body on a match. One failing read never fails the others.

head.description: Checks reachability when the event stream is disconnected. Requires a Bearer token.

get.description: Streams listener-scoped JSON payloads with increasing id, event and data lines. Replay uses Last-Event-ID (preferred) or lastEventId, retaining at most 1,000 events for 10 minutes. An unknown or expired cursor starts with resync {}; refetch client state, then continue live. Comments ping every 25 seconds. Connections share the v1 limit: 8 per listener, 256 total; excess returns 503. Payloads: track.updated {track: V2Track}, lyrics.updated {trackId, revision} (read views=lyrics), match.updated {trackId, state}, keep.updated {trackId, state, progress}, mix.updated {mixId, playlistId}, releases.updated {count}, libraryAddition.updated {row}, track.renamed {old, new}. Renames reach currently connected v2 listeners. Requires a Bearer token.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last received event id; takes precedence over the query parameter.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Replay cursor for clients unable to set Last-Event-ID.

Never opens audio, issues a stream link or prepares a source. Another listener's playback returns 404. Retained in memory for up to twelve hours. Can also be read inside a batch.

parameters.description: The stored ETag; a matching representation returns 304 without a body.

post.description: Selects a playback format and returns a signed stream URL valid for twelve hours. cacheKey hashes the track, tier, delivered format and source identity, never the listener or signed token. Source identity uses the library item's version stamp when available, a stored file's path, size and modification time, or the provider track and source format. Same inputs produce the same key. Only stored files and original/pass-through provider bytes can report seek=bytes and contentLength. Live transcodes report seek=none and contentLength=null; Range requests return 200 with the full stream. Clients may resume only streams reporting seek=bytes. Prefetch may move the source into cache without invalidating the URL.

get.description: Reads the track, delivered format and tier authorized by the signed URL without an authorization header. The source may move between a provider and cache after prefetch. Stored files and pass-through provider streams support byte ranges when advertised by resolve; live transcodes ignore Range and return 200 with the full stream. Bad, expired and foreign tokens return 404.

aliases.description: The same artist's older id, as search and artist pages use it today.

by.description: `songs` when matched songs tie them, `fix` when a person said so.

scope.description: For a fix: `household` when an administrator set it for everyone, `you` when it is this listener's own.

same.description: `true`: the same artist. `false`: a different act.

links.description: Service artists shown as this library artist.

notSame.description: Service artists someone said are a different act; search keeps them apart.

next.description: Opaque continuation cursor; null when exhausted. A partial page can have no tracks and still have a next cursor.

path.description: A v2 GET path with its query, such as `/allstarr/v2/tracks/trk_…?views=lyrics`.

ifNoneMatch.description: The route's stored ETag. A match returns 304 with no body.

bitDepth.description: Bits per sample; null for lossy codecs.

text.description: Null when no translation is needed or the result was dropped.

lines.description: One entry per lyrics view line, in the same order, including blank and untranslated lines.

id.description: Stable id. `trk_` plus the recording when the song has one, so it survives keeping, adding to the library and rematching.

aliases.description: Other ids this track answers to, including the ones in the request.

libraryItemId.description: The media server item when the song is in the library.

externalIds.description: Known identifiers such as `isrc`, `musicbrainzRecording` and the service's own id under its name.

featuring.description: Track artists after the first who are not album artists.

anyOf.description: The stored or measured file, not what a stream will deliver.

canonicalRecordingId.description: The recording identity, when known, shared by library and service copies.

views.description: Requested views keyed by returned track id.
